# AaiSaheb Foundation

> AaiSaheb Foundation is a community-focused NGO working to support children, families and communities through meaningful social initiatives and community programmes in Navi Mumbai and surrounding areas.

## About

- https://aaisahebfoundation.org/about/
- Mission and Vision
- Learn about AaiSaheb Foundation, its purpose, values and approach to community service.

## Events

- https://aaisahebfoundation.org/events/
- Year-wise record of events and social initiatives organised by AaiSaheb Foundation.
- Includes community service, education support, health initiatives and other social activities.
